description: This Java class implements a TreeTableModel for visualizing method statistics from a VM Trace, with methods for setting trace data, thread, and clock type, and for managing tree structure and sorting.

classes.name: VmStatsTreeTableModel
classes.description: A TreeTableModel for viewing method statistics from a VM Trace, delegating most methods to StatsNode instances.

methods.name: setTraceData
methods.description: Sets the VM trace data and thread, updating the root node accordingly.

methods.name: setClockType
methods.description: Sets the clock type used for statistics and refreshes the tree structure.

methods.name: setThread
methods.description: Sets the thread info and updates the root node based on trace data and thread.

methods.name: fireTreeStructureChanged
methods.description: Notifies listeners that the tree structure has changed.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a column based on its index.

methods.name: getStatsTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the StatsTableColumn enum corresponding to a column index.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type for a column, with the first column being TreeTableModel and others String.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Returns the value at a specific node and column, delegating to StatsNode.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that cells are not editable.

methods.name: setTree
methods.description: Empty implementation for setting the tree.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root node of the tree.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns the child node at a given index for a parent node.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the number of children for a parent node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Determines if a node is a leaf.

methods.name: getIndexOfChild
methods.description: Returns the index of a child within a parent; currently always returns 0.

methods.name: sortByColumn
methods.description: Sorts the root node's children based on the specified column and toggles sort order.
